3257.title: Follow-up reasoning selection is not saved as the thread default
3257.rootCauseOneLine: The follow-up reasoning picker updates component-local state and the turn request but never invokes the existing thread update mutation.
3257.proposedFix: Persist picker changes through the existing thread update mutation while retaining immediate local selection.
3257.caveats: The selector stayed High through turn completion in the isolated Codex run and returned to Max only after reload; Pi had no model catalog in the isolated fixture.
